title: Tomatoes in coffee cans
subject: Abuela Marisol
text: Abuela Marisol grew tomatoes in old coffee cans along the back fence and gave every plant a name. The biggest one was called Don Ramón.

title: Sunday pan dulce
subject: Abuela Marisol
text: Every Sunday she walked to the corner bakery before church and came back with conchas wrapped in paper. She always saved the pink one for me.

title: Her radio
subject: Abuela Marisol
text: She kept a yellow radio on the kitchen windowsill, tuned to old boleros, and hummed while she shelled beans.

title: Why Lumen stopped
subject: Lumen RSS
text: Lumen RSS was my abandoned feed reader. I stopped working on it after version 0.3 when the parser rewrite got too big for evenings after work.

title: The first commit
subject: Lumen RSS
text: The first commit was at 2 a.m. and just said 'it fetches one feed'. I was ridiculously proud of it.
